headline: The sharpened exact null-pair-plus-square ceiling survives arbitrary curvature on one null-pair coordinate and arbitrary physical shear from that coordinate into the square receiver: Q=rX^2+2aXY+2cXZ+bZ^2+affine has the same global density bound C(a,b), for arbitrary independent cap-one laws.

main_result.family: Q=rX^2+2aXY+2cXZ+bZ^2+uX+vY+wZ+q0, with independent densities <=1 and a,b nonzero
main_result.mechanism: translate X to remove vY; solve linearly in Y; complete the x-dependent Z-square; use simultaneous probability-mass and parabola-preimage caps; outer cap-one bathtub in X
main_result.spectrum_certificate: A_*^2-I=[[5,2,3],[2,3,2],[3,2,4]] has leading principal minors 5,11,21>0, hence all |lambda(A_*)|>1
main_result.explicit_ceiling: for A_*, a=b=2 and ||p||_infinity<=1+log2=1.693147180559945... for every cap-one product law

required_source_applied.application: Pinned Theorem C applies to the actual physical target matrix A_* because its signature is (+,+,-) and A_*^2-I is positive definite. It yields sup_{s>=0} p_{Q_*}(s)<=pi sqrt2; the new original-coordinate theorem strengthens the same witness globally to 1+log2.

partner_applied.application: Its exact two-cap parabola-preimage lemma I_y<=min(1,2sqrt(2|ay|/|b|)) is reused after completing the sheared Z-square. The estimate is translation-uniform, so arbitrary rX^2 and cXZ survive without changing the constant.

unresolved_implication: Destroy the exact null leaf while preserving target spectrum and arbitrary cap-one sources: add a nonzero Y^2 pivot or YZ edge, or use several non-collinear/shared macroscopic rows. The current linear-root/parabola-preimage mechanism then no longer closes.
next_step: Analyze a quantitative near-null perturbation Q=dY^2+2aXY+rX^2+2cXZ+2eYZ+bZ^2 with d or e nonzero, seeking a uniform target-range ceiling or a source-valid overshoot; do not use post-rotation independence or generic two-sheet X-ray control.
